message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openssl && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('fuzz/client.c')
s=p.read_text()
# Try forcing a TLS1.2 resumption/PSK-like path and keep handshake minimal.
s=s.replace('    OPENSSL_assert(SSL_set_cipher_list(client, "PSK-AES128-CBC-SHA:PSK-AES256-CBC-SHA:DHE-RSA-AES128-SHA") == 1);\n','    OPENSSL_assert(SSL_set_cipher_list(client, "PSK-AES128-CBC-SHA:RSA-PSK-AES128-CBC-SHA:DHE-RSA-AES128-SHA") == 1);\n')
if 'SSL_set_max_proto_version' not in s:
    s=s.replace('    OPENSSL_assert(SSL_set_min_proto_version(client, 0) == 1);\n', '    OPENSSL_assert(SSL_set_min_proto_version(client, TLS1_2_VERSION) == 1);\n    OPENSSL_assert(SSL_set_max_proto_version(client, TLS1_2_VERSION) == 1);\n')
# restore no verify with PSK callback, remove host name noise if any not needed
p.write_text(s)
print('patched4')
PY
sed -n '72,92p' fuzz/client.c
